node.statement: The coherence external is conditional on two already-constructed polar data. Node 1.7.4 supplies that antecedent only for (delta,S_delta,u_pol,h_pol). With no independently established datum containing u_grp, coherence cannot be instantiated to compare u_grp with u_pol; instantiating both indices with the retraction datum proves only (u_pol,h_pol)=(u_pol,h_pol). Consequently the former positive synchronization claim is withdrawn, and the exact inputs leave u_grp=u_pol unproved.
